summary: Afya Limited, a Brazilian for-profit education company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose to R$985.2 million from R$928.5 million a year earlier, operating income to R$304.8 million from R$277.4 million, and net income reached R$171.0 million. Total assets were R$9.66 billion and equity R$5.10 billion. No transactional event, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine periodic earnings filing, not a special situation.
